name: Welsh Cake
desc: Picau ar y maen: flour, butter, currants and sugar, cooked on a hot bakestone and never in an oven. Swansea Market sells them warm. Restores 90 HP.

name: Laverbread
desc: Laver seaweed off the Gower rocks, boiled for hours into a black purée and fried with oatmeal. Richard Burton called it Welshman's caviar. Restores 160 HP.

name: Penclawdd Cockles
desc: A bag of cockles hand-raked and riddled on the sands of the Burry Inlet this morning. Megan at Swansea Market is waiting for them.

name: Under Milk Wood
desc: A dog-eared copy of Dylan Thomas's play for voices, signed by the cast of the Dylan Thomas Centre reading. Llareggub is best read backwards.

name: Copper Slag
desc: A glassy black lump off the old Hafod tips. Swansea cast it into blocks for walls and copings, so half the old town is built of the copper industry's leftovers.

name: Copper Sheathing
desc: A square of Swansea copper, the sort nailed below a wooden ship's waterline to keep shipworm and weed off the hull. The Navy coppered its fleet with it.
effect_text: Tide moves hurt it a quarter less.
